reason: I already have a robo-adviser that rebalances for a fraction of a percent with no monthly bill, so I'm not signing up for another subscription with no price on it. And a cartoon pet running my paycheck money doesn't make me feel safer.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money, and a flat monthly fee on top of fund costs eats into returns on my balance more than my robo-adviser does.
would_change_my_mind: If the real-money plan cost less than my robo-adviser's fee on my balance, or was free with no subscription, and the broker partner was a name I already trust.
